[↑↓/jk] move between entries
[enter] run the command under the pointer again
[c] copy the command to the clipboard
[ctrl+s] save the command as a snippet
[d] delete the entry, after confirming it
[/] filter by what was asked or by what came back
[backspace] delete a character from the filter
[esc] clear the filter, close it, then back to the shell

glyphs
⚙  a read: a file, a search, a listing
$  a shell command
✎  an edit, a write, a patch or a memory
◇  a sub-agent
⇄  a call to a server not marked read-only
✻  the model writing its calls, counted as they arrive
⛁  a published report page
≡  a reading of the session
✓  a compaction that brought the window back
·  accepted, not started
▸  running
✦  the classifier is deciding
✗  failed
⊘  refused: dim by you, red by a rule
[?] hide the keys
